name: photo-chromatic-abstraction-style-1
title_zh: 把照片转成色块记忆的极简抽象画
tagline_zh: 照片变画布：只留大色块与1-5个克制点缀，色彩权重优先于构图。适合色卡转译、色彩构成练习，让记忆以颜色留存。
tagline_en: Turn photos into flat-field color memories—1-5 restrained accents, hierarchy over placement. For palette studies.
desc_en: Translate an uploaded or local photograph into a color-first chromatic-memory abstraction (Style 1) built from adaptive flat fields and 1-5 restrained, source-derived accents. Use for palette-memory composition, color-weight studies, minimalist color-block translation, 色块抽象、照片色彩记忆、色彩构成、照片色卡转译，or explicit Style-1 requests where broad color hierarchy matters more than subject placement. Do not use w
why_zh: 不按主体位置切分，而是按色彩权重自适应生成色场，让颜色本身成为构图骨架，而非附庸于轮廓。
why_en: Segments by color weight, not subject placement—flat fields carry the composition, so hue hierarchy drives structure, not.
limit_zh: 只处理单张静态照片，不生成多图序列；输出为抽象色块图，不保留可辨识主体；需本地有Python图像库。
limit_en: Single static photo only; output is abstract blocks, no recognizable subject; requires local Python imaging libs; high-noise images compress to.
